info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Logistics Shipments API allows users to revoke or cancel pending logistics shipment requests. It is designed for businesses looking to manage their shipment operations effectively by providing a straightforward method to cancel shipments before they are processed. This API is particularly useful for logistics managers and dispatch teams who need to quickly adjust shipment statuses due to changes in delivery requirements or customer needs. By reducing the time and effort needed to cancel shipments, this API enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing shipment. Ensure that the shipment is eligible for cancellation before proceeding.

requestBody.description: Request body to cancel a shipment. The payload must contain the necessary identification details to process the cancellation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: A JSON string that represents the request body for canceling a shipment operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Shipment Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment after the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing details about the cancellation operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: The response object indicating the result of a shipment cancellation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that initiated the operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
